decisions.title: rpc : avoid stack exhaustion in create_node with deep graphs
decisions.head: 2514265f81b506b112d2841097876033318e0137
decisions.reason: Iterative reachable-node materialization; tensor_map replaces the redundant extra seen set; 300000-node traversal and shared/view/error contracts.

decisions.title: gguf : retain zero-sized dimensions while trimming trailing ones
decisions.head: 8025df58c4d12ec6b19fc37c0ac1adbe5b397ef0
decisions.reason: Writer trims trailing ones, retaining zero axes; eight real GGUF round trips preserve the following tensor.

decisions.title: llama : reuse scheduler buffers across requests
decisions.head: 52b443a0f06d4448a2fb4d4306e61e1481f523c9
decisions.reason: Retain scheduler capacity and its allocated buffers; preserve explicit no-pipeline retry. Startup/build checked; no multi-request speed claim.

decisions.title: ggml-backend: don't upload inputs that are not read
decisions.head: 6f21a64a0293b23952ca97c2f5c6fea66955c051
decisions.reason: Conditional graph-branch input uploads need the matching forward-select semantics and backend transfer tests. No measured benefit on the current fixed graph; avoid a speculative global-copy gate.

decisions.title: vulkan: avoid redundant scans when zeroing skipped rows
decisions.head: d3909e1776c476c222743712fc002d623e15a7b2
decisions.reason: count_experts.comp already counts skipped rows and cooperatively clears only the skipped slots.

decisions.title: vulkan: reuse Q8_0 weights in MMVQ for 9-16 columns
decisions.head: 7709e9ef244563fc2f58ab2488aa6b8e0f7b064e
decisions.reason: Wide Q8 MMVQ uses integer-dot hardware absent on Polaris. Reusing A is useful, but a scalar wide kernel has different register/occupancy costs and no qualification here; no capability spoof.

decisions.title: vulkan : check combined K+V f16 scratch size in FA dequant path
decisions.head: c4b3e91c432313170496cd0c092f36b360a113af
decisions.reason: Combined K+V allocation limits are checked in the accepted Vulkan source.

decisions.title: ggml-cpu x86: fix Q8_0 dot product sign error for -128 (issue #29351)
decisions.head: 52d9833fedc7789734248a15a117844f3dd4aefc
decisions.reason: Clamping -128 to -127 changes the dot product. Use exact operand contracts from29359 instead.

decisions.title: ggml-cpu x86: exact -128 handling in int8 dot-product helpers (fix #29351; excludes q1_0, iq2_*, iq3_*, sgemm, repack)
decisions.head: 9c86968a048a27b5222e3db6357f617907110f67
decisions.reason: Thirty checked x86 hunks; bounded-weight operand order and guarded Q8 widening. Nine type pairs,256 cases:188 failures before,zero after; excluded kernels remain excluded.

decisions.title: gguf: fix tensor shape overflow check mismatch and add regression test (#1668)
decisions.head: 497dfdc4791b2988a22c7a8cbff158a171d9de89
decisions.reason: Reader bound matches the constructor even after zero axes and rejects equality before an assert.

decisions.title: ggml-rpc : fix tensor bounds checks, recv_msg length_error, and destr…
decisions.head: 14e1e905c8e7455d1cdcee800030437cddc975c9
decisions.reason: Remaining deserialize/set/hash/get/copy bounds use checked subtraction; receive length_error/destructor synchronization already upstream.4320 span cases.

decisions.title: ggml : fix ubsan error in `ggml_graph_nbytes`
decisions.head: 8dc59f82aa89d81ff86e1b790d1a689332a961c5
decisions.reason: ggml_graph_nbytes already uses the non-null1024 sentinel and subtracts it.

decisions.title: Add new config option for the soft-limit percent
decisions.head: cfcaf23cbfc779c9b1f55a9a7ee948189ecb7313
decisions.reason: Maintainer resolved warning noise with quiet-mode gating; preserve current settings rather than add a redundant warning option.

decisions.title: Enable option for RPC server tensor cache in host mode
decisions.head: de155c6b84095d8656c4df58ecfc672dfc94b5db
decisions.reason: Explicit RPC cache directory and GUI field are present; leave optional caching unchanged.

decisions.title: sd: fix VAE tiling adjustment to never reduce tile size
decisions.head: f6d88b26df96442a1c050c28a94733c345cb54f2
decisions.reason: VAE threshold rounds to64 and respects the upstream256 minimum without shrinking the default tile.

decisions.title: vulkan: fix struct padding in VkDeviceQueueInfo2 for translation layers
decisions.head: 072081928c86e848141d0bfafdcd4c4eb9a55d43
decisions.reason: Zero full flagged queue descriptors, use ordinary getQueue without flags; preserve selected queues and NVIDIA synchronization.

decisions.title: fix grammar rejection cache: store reject indices, not candidate pointers
decisions.head: e069a43007d4073a16ec5f51780abc5a804133b5
decisions.reason: Current grammar memo stores candidate indices and rebuilds current pointers; it no longer caches stale candidate pointers.

decisions.title: server : clear slot cache when the global lora config changes
decisions.head: f410eebbe0fb43dfc37cee868f68e6f592f21e20
decisions.reason: Patch targets llama-server slot/global-LoRA handling. Kobold uses its own adapter/request lifecycle; no llama-server slot implementation is built. No assertion that arbitrary dynamic-LoRA paths were exhaustively tested.

decisions.title: vulkan: Add 'readonly' to decodeBuf declarations.
decisions.head: 054c1f3d1efdca7f4a189ab2f597b2e24203dde8
decisions.reason: Readonly decodeBuf is a cooperative-matrix2 path. Polaris does not execute it; no unmeasured device code change is needed for this build.

decisions.title: fix for two functions when top_k exceeds the vocabulary size.
decisions.head: a57b656f51c0fe5acbb2e5037a7c68eb4a00379c
decisions.reason: Changes GPT examples; current production sampler already bounds top-k by the candidate count.

search_scope: Four focused searches,100-result cap per search; metadata screening is separate from these20 semantic diff reviews. Earlier exhaustive November7 remaining queue is unchanged.

strata.scope: All patch artifacts fetched/pinned, aggregate file index and full-text screen, selected CPU/memory/I-O/security diffs reviewed. The1580kB aggregate is not claimed line-by-line semantically audited.
adapted: Exact IQ4_NL split-half decode adapted to AVX2 shared row decoder
not_selected: CUDA PCIe overlap/static addresses require the Strata CUDA verifier and cannot be enabled in Vulkan by copying streams; existing backend async copies retain their dependencies.
Transposed reduction and staged codebooks were not selected upstream on P40 after noisy/regressing model tests. No unsupported RX580 integer-dot/warp32 assumptions.
AVX1 h2f and row interleaving target a different kernel; Haswell uses F16C and existing AVX2 dots.
NUMA arena changes are off by default on their source and unmeasured on this single-node machine; existing affinity policy is preserved.
